init.title: Online Service options
init.description: The electricity price is used for the Energy dashboard: Home Assistant cannot apply a fixed price to the meter reading consumption statistic, so the integration writes a matching cost statistic (Vattenfall Meter Reading Cost) from it. Leave it empty to stop writing costs. Data is downloaded from Vattenfall once per download interval; use the Download data now button to download earlier.

data_description.energy_price: Working price per kWh incl. VAT, e.g. 0.294 for 29.40 cent/kWh. It applies to the whole reading history.
data_description.update_interval_days: Days between downloads from Vattenfall (default 30). Restarting Home Assistant does not download again before the interval has passed.
